REPORT
Date August 26, 1937

Subject Communication dated 23-8-37 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning Miss L.M. Eichenbaum
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev.    Forwarded by C. Crawford. D.I.

Miss Lucie (Ludmila Mihailovna) Eichenbaum, Russian of Jewish extraction, was born on August 13, 1908 at Warsaw and is the daughter of M.B. Eichenbaum, local merchant, who died in October, 1935 at Hongkong. She has been residing in Shanghai since 1919. Upon leaving school she was employed in the Advertising Department of the "China Press" from 1926 to 1930. Later she was employed for a period in the Anglo-Chinese Trading Corporation and for the past two or three years is reported to have been working as a private teacher. She is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee, No 118/1 Boulmein Road and her last known address is No 119 Great Western Road.

Two of her elder sisters are married to J.G. Vanchurin, a registered Netherlands subject of Russian origin, and to Dr. Baldwin, American, respectively. Miss Alexandra Eichenbaum, another sister of hers, forms the subject of communication dated 9-2-37 from the Netherlands Consulate-General in connection with her application for a visa for admission into Netherlands Indies.

Mr. V.J. Palstra, Miss Eichenbaum's fiance, was formerly J.G. Vanchurin's partner in the Commonwealth Product Co., 72 Szechuen Road, and at present is reported to be connected with the Oriental Trading & Engineering Corp., 660-8 Szechuen Road.

Nothing is known against Miss Eichenbaum either politically or criminally.

D7793

A. Prokopiev
D. S. I.

报告
日期：1937年8月26日

事由：荷兰总领事馆1937年8月23日来函，涉及L.M. Eichenbaum小姐
由 D.S.I. Prokofiev 撰写。    由 C. Crawford. D.I. 转呈。

Lucie (Ludmila Mihailovna) Eichenbaum小姐，俄裔犹太人，1908年8月13日出生于华沙，系本地商人M.B. Eichenbaum之女，其父于1935年10月在香港去世。她自1919年起居住在上海。离校后，她于1926年至1930年间受雇于《字林西报》（China Press）广告部。此后，她曾在英华贸易公司（Anglo-Chinese Trading Corporation）任职一段时间，据报在过去两三年中一直担任私人教师。她在莫尔缅路（Boulmein Road）118/1号的俄罗斯移民委员会登记注册，其最后已知地址为大西路（Great Western Road）119号。

她的两位姐姐分别嫁给了J.G. Vanchurin（一位已登记的俄裔荷兰籍人士）和Baldwin博士（美国人）。她的另一位姐妹Alexandra Eichenbaum小姐，是荷兰总领事馆1937年2月9日来函的主题，该函涉及其申请进入荷属东印度的签证事宜。

V.J. Palstra先生，即Eichenbaum小姐的未婚夫，曾是J.G. Vanchurin在联邦产品公司（Commonwealth Product Co.，四川路72号）的合伙人，据报目前与东方贸易工程公司（Oriental Trading & Engineering Corp.，四川路660-8号）有关联。

无论是在政治方面还是刑事方面，均未发现Eichenbaum小姐有任何不良记录。

D7793

A. Prokopiev
D. S. I.

d.
D. C. ( Special Branch )
DOR.
26/8
